messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming-response-latency breach detected for /v1/live/stream (p95 1.8s -> 9.2s, p99 3.6s -> 18.7s). Affected region: eu-west-1. Error spike: proxy timeouts and client stalls. Paging on-call.
alex_oncall: ack. I'm on it. tagging runtime + sres. @sara_runtime @mike_sre can you join? customer-impact unknown yet. I'll gather asap.
sara_runtime: joining. seeing increased tail latency on the SSE websocket gateway. metrics look like backpressure causing proxy write buffers to pile up.
mike_sre: oncall here. I already see a bunch of 502/504s from the edge proxy to streaming backend. also some envoy upstream resets.
jess_prodops: looping in product ops and CSM for potential customer notification: @lina_csm FYI.
lina_csm: received, will stand by. any customers with active live sessions? we should check top talkers.
alex_oncall: quick checks: `kubectl top pods -n gateway` looks healthy CPU/RAM, but socket queues are growing. Running a PromQL to confirm tail:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"/v1/live.*"}[2m])) by (le))
```
returns ~18s at p99.
sara_runtime: logs show clients not ACKing chunks, gateway is holding chunks in memory -> long tail. sample from gateway logs:
```
2026-06-01T15:32:01Z gateway-5b7 error write: connection reset by peer id=abc123 route=/v1/live/stream session=xyz
2026-06-01T15:32:03Z gateway-5b7 warn chunk_buffer=524288 pending=72
```
mike_sre: likely two contributors: 1) proxy keepalive/write_timeout too low for some slow clients causing abrupt resets and retries, 2) client-level backpressure (slow consumer) that fills gateway buffers and stalls other streams.
sara_runtime: mitigation idea: temporarily increase proxy upstream write_timeout and enable chunked-flush mode (small-batch flush) for live endpoints. that'll lower per-client buffer retention.
alex_oncall: can we do a config bump with minimal risk? what's the exact command? @deploy-bot can we patch gateway config to increase `upstream_write_timeout` from 15s -> 45s in eu-west-1? and flip `stream.flush_mode=chunked-small` feature flag for the route?
deploy-bot: deploy playbook run queued. to confirm, changing `upstream_write_timeout` requires a rolling restart of gateway pods in the eu-west-1 deployment; feature flag flip is dynamic.
mike_sre: i'm comfortable with feature flag flip first. low risk. Alex — flip it and watch for memory spikes.
sara_runtime: I'll prepare a patch for the gateway config if feature flag doesn't reduce p99 within 2m. Suggest also enabling client-heartbeat-probe (soft keepalive) for long-lived connections.
alex_oncall: flipping flag now: `redwood-ffctl set stream.flush_mode chunked-small --scope eu-west-1 --route /v1/live/stream` -> done. :white_check_mark:
(sara_runtime reacted :thumbsup:)

6m later...
sara_runtime: p95 dropped to ~2.1s, p99 to ~6.9s. still elevated but improving. chunk memory in gateway decreased by ~65%.
mike_sre: good. hold on finalizing expiry. I'll keep monitoring. if p99 stays >5s after 10m we do config restart bump.
alex_oncall: Lina — any early customer reports?
lina_csm: one enterprise customer on eu-west long live feed reported occasional stalls at 15:36. I've opened a support ticket and sent the temporary mitigation update.
jess_prodops: prepping a short incident note for status page and slack customers. nothing public yet until stable.
sara_runtime: follow-up tasks: 1) run detailed trace capture for affected sessions (enabled). 2) collect proxy histograms for 1h window. 3) autoscale gateway burst policy review (might need tuning to avoid queueing).
mike_sre: ops task: if p99 rises again, we will increase `upstream_write_timeout` to 60s and then perform a rolling restart with 30s drain to avoid connection drop amplification.
alex_oncall: leaving initial on-call. handing to @mike_sre for the next 30m watch. I'll be reachable. summary -> feature flag flip reduced buffer usage and lowered p99 from 18.7s to 6.9s. customer impact: intermittent stalls for a small set of slow consumers. Action items logged.
mike_sre: taking watch. adding note to pager duty incident: "Late-chunk/heartbeat mitigation: FF flip applied, monitoring p95/p99, next step config bump and rolling restart if p99 > 5s for 10m." tagging runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/streaming-late-chunks
alex_oncall: thanks team. I'll update incident-bot with resolution once all metrics stable. :pray:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (feature-flag: chunked-small), severity: S3 -> monitoring. assigned to: mike_sre. incident created: PD-12345.
